scheme_name: Coaching Help Scheme for JEE-GUJCET-NEET Exams
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to a non‑reserved category
Applicant must have obtained 70% or more marks in Class 10th/11th/12th
Applicant must be from Science stream
Applicant must be pursuing coaching for JEE, GUJCET, or NEET
Coaching institute must have at least 3 years of experience
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to ₹20,000 per year per student, or actual coaching fee whichever is lower.
